carryover: Credential consent leases existed, but authenticated browser profile, session, account, and cookie-jar access needed explicit default-deny policy semantics.
confirmedDecisions: Browser profile/cookie access must be blocked by default.
Explicit domain/session/account leases may allow bounded access.
Cookie values and credentials remain redacted or never stored.
Revocation must immediately make the same requirement fail.
newGoal: Implement the browser profile permission model over consent leases with revoke, redaction, audit, and smoke coverage.
